item.text: I’m looking for the next high-value split in the terminal UI layer. The input path is already separated, so I’m checking whether the remaining interaction helper should be broken into a smaller content/report helper or a keyboard-state helper.

I’m extracting the remaining transcript/share/report/paste workflow into its own helper. That pulls a separate concern out of `TermuxTerminalViewInteractionHelper` and leaves the latter focused on view state and keyboard behavior.

I’ve added the new action helper. I’m now deleting the duplicated content/report methods from the interaction helper and replacing them with simple delegations so there’s one implementation of that behavior.
The content/report split is in place. I’m checking the resulting helper for missing imports or stale methods so I can leave it in a compilable state instead of just structurally split.
I found the only likely compile risk from the extraction: the interaction helper lost a few imports that its `onSingleTapUp` and key-routing code still need. I’m restoring those now.
I’ve restored the missing imports. I’m doing one last sweep of the tail of the helper to make sure the new delegate methods and the existing shortcut logic still line up cleanly after the extraction.
I’ve verified the delegate methods are still wired through. I’m only checking the import block now, because that’s the one place the last extraction could still be hiding a broken symbol reference.
I’m checking for any leftover references to the old session-client field in `TermuxTerminalViewClient`; if any remain, they would indicate the extraction left dead state behind.

Extracted the remaining transcript/share/report/paste workflow into a dedicated helper.

- Added [TermuxTerminalViewActionHelper.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/terminal/TermuxTerminalViewActionHelper.java)
  - Owns transcript sharing
  - Owns selected-text sharing
  - Owns URL selection dialog behavior
  - Owns report-issue generation
  - Owns paste-from-clipboard behavior

- Updated [TermuxTerminalViewInteractionHelper.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/terminal/TermuxTerminalViewInteractionHelper.java)
  - Delegates those content/report actions to the new helper
  - Keeps keyboard state, soft keyboard control, cursor blinking, and session shortcut parsing

This further reduces the interaction helper’s responsibility and separates UI state from user-content actions.

I did not rerun a full build here; the workspace still lacks `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar`, so Gradle-based verification remains blocked.
